reviews.text:
Update June 2025:
We have been working with EAV Construction since May 2025 to replace our driveway and add a concrete slab for a shed next to our house. Additionally, they added landscaping gravel on both sides of the driveway.

We have been so happy with all of the work they've done in the past and continue to do presently. EAV will be our go-to for any house related construction or repair needs.

----------
We were connected with EAV Construction through Integrity Pools, as part of our pool d

American Pool Construction is amazing! Absolutely the best value, communication, design skills, etc. Erik was amazing to work with on our very complicated pool build. We interviewed over 7 pools builders and I can say without a doubt Erik with American Pool Construction was the right choice. Here's some of the construction pics...

After 17 years of walking on uneven flagstone pathways my wife and I decided to have concrete sidewalks and sitting areas installed.  Erik and his crew did an outstanding job working with us on the design.  We changed things up more than once and they were all very patient and professional.  I was worried about drainage but they installed a drainage system that works better than what we had before. In all they removed about 370 sq. ft. of old concrete and a few hundred pieces of flagstone then f

Erik and his team did our back driveway and completely exceeded our expectations! He constantly stayed in communication throughout the whole project from start to finish. EAV Construction goes above and beyond with any project you might have in mind.

We were referred to EAV Construction and Erik through Integrity Pools. We had a plumbing leak under the deck to our pool as well as tree roots that were pushing the deck up. We have limited access to our pool, so the deck had to be jack hammered out, then wheelbarrowed to the curb. The work crew led by Erik's dad was very careful not to damage anything. It took them a whole day to remove a multitude of tree roots using axes and shovels, before they could pour the new deck which they had to wheel
Excellent work and professionalism. They constantly maintained communication throughout the process and never deviated from timelines.

Erik and his team were absolutely amazing! I called him on a very long shot to see if he could come install an above ground pool for me. He came out, gave me a quote, and it was completed in a matter of a couple days. I HIGHLY recommend him for any outdoor/exterior projects. He even gave me ideas on building an inground pool, which I will eventually take him up on.

He is very professional, priced competitively and is local to Garland. I will be telling everyone I know about his company.

Thank

We have had the pleasure of working with Erik for the last 3 months on a major pool and deck renovation, a concrete patio and pad for sport court renovation, and the replacement of the front walkway and sidewalk.  Erik and/or his father were there almost every day supervising the work and making sure his workers and subs made everything perfect.  His prices were fair and more competitive than his peers.  He went above and beyond our expectations!

We were incredibly impressed with their professionalism from start to finish-  They created beautiful drawings of our backyard oasis and finished it up very quickly (Actually, sooner than quoted) We We happy with both the price and quality of work! Can’t say enough good about Eric and his crew!!!!

We contracted Erik at EAV construction to redo our driveway and build us a large Stamped concrete patio and walkway. The guys were very professional and worked in the scorching 110° heat to complete the project. We are very happy with the finished project and highly recommend Eav construction for any of your concrete projects!!

I hired EAV Construction to replace the decking and enlarge it on our 45 year old pool.  From start to finish, Eric, the project manager, was in constant communication.  The work was done on time and the entire team worked tirelessly and were extremely conscientious.  They even added drainage to ensure there would be no water puddling.  The pool deck turned out amazing. They also were able to dye the concrete a warm wheat color so that it would blend better with the coping and pool decor.  I can

American Pool Construction completely rebuilt my outdated pool deck that was cracked and worn down.  They were on time, courteous, and within a little over a week had finished demolition of my existing concrete deck, removed the debris , reinforced the footing and poured new concrete.  They were efficient and hard working.  I am very satisfied with the finished product and would recommend them to anyone.

EAV Construction did a fabulous job tying our pool in with our patio enclosure. They provided proper drainage and beautifully matching concrete. I would highly recommend EAV for any outdoor construction project.
My mother had Eric put in a french drain after this last round of storms.  The price was more than fair and the work was outstanding!  I would definitely recommend them!
Our HOA pool and deck is complete and we are so excited! Communication has been amazing. Work was done well and in a timely manner. Amazing crew! Cleanup has also been great! Can’t wait to jump in!
Erik and team were excellent! Erik was very helpful in answering all of our questions and the concrete decking turned out great!
Beautiful repair of the stonework and foundation of our outdoor spa. Excellent work -- fast, affordable, and honest. And, completely and utterly reliable.
Excellent work—fast honest reliable…did beautiful work
The best communication and execution!

Update June 2025:
We have been working with EAV Construction since May 2025 to replace our driveway and add a concrete slab for a shed next to our house. Additionally, they added landscaping gravel on both sides of the driveway.

We have been so happy with all of the work they've done in the past and continue to do presently. EAV will be our go-to for any house related construction or repair needs.

----------
We were connected with EAV Construction through Integrity Pools, as part of our pool d

American Pool Construction is amazing! Absolutely the best value, communication, design skills, etc. Erik was amazing to work with on our very complicated pool build. We interviewed over 7 pools builders and I can say without a doubt Erik with American Pool Construction was the right choice. Here's some of the construction pics...

After 17 years of walking on uneven flagstone pathways my wife and I decided to have concrete sidewalks and sitting areas installed.  Erik and his crew did an outstanding job working with us on the design.  We changed things up more than once and they were all very patient and professional.  I was worried about drainage but they installed a drainage system that works better than what we had before. In all they removed about 370 sq. ft. of old concrete and a few hundred pieces of flagstone then f

Erik and his team did our back driveway and completely exceeded our expectations! He constantly stayed in communication throughout the whole project from start to finish. EAV Construction goes above and beyond with any project you might have in mind.

We were referred to EAV Construction and Erik through Integrity Pools. We had a plumbing leak under the deck to our pool as well as tree roots that were pushing the deck up. We have limited access to our pool, so the deck had to be jack hammered out, then wheelbarrowed to the curb. The work crew led by Erik's dad was very careful not to damage anything. It took them a whole day to remove a multitude of tree roots using axes and shovels, before they could pour the new deck which they had to wheel
Excellent work and professionalism. They constantly maintained communication throughout the process and never deviated from timelines.

Erik and his team were absolutely amazing! I called him on a very long shot to see if he could come install an above ground pool for me. He came out, gave me a quote, and it was completed in a matter of a couple days. I HIGHLY recommend him for any outdoor/exterior projects. He even gave me ideas on building an inground pool, which I will eventually take him up on.

He is very professional, priced competitively and is local to Garland. I will be telling everyone I know about his company.

Thank

We have had the pleasure of working with Erik for the last 3 months on a major pool and deck renovation, a concrete patio and pad for sport court renovation, and the replacement of the front walkway and sidewalk.
